sloka: यथैव धेनुः स्रवति स्नेहाद्वत्सस्य वत्सला ।तथा ममापि हृदयं मणिरत्नस्य दर्शनात् ।। ५.६६.३ ।।।।
transliteration: yathaiva dhenuḥ sravati snehādvatsasya vatsalā ।tathā mamāpi hṛdayaṁ maṇiratnasya darśanāt ।। 5.66.3 ।।।।

translations.english: "Just as a cow fond of its calf begins to distil milk from its teats at the sight of the calf, so does my heart melt at the sight of this excellent jewel.
